cause_quote: `const resources = () => (resourcesPromise ??= createCuaExecutionResources(options));` cached the initialization promise even when it rejected.
user_saw: After repairing a temporary resource directory problem, users still got the original filesystem error when they retried recording or closed the same computer execution.
summary: The fix clears the cached resource initialization promise on rejection so the same execution can retry recording or close.
reasoning: The recording feature's introducing diff cached the initialization promise for subsequent actions and awaited that same promise during close, so both paths inherited the first rejection. I checked the later resource initialization fix, which changed how the directory was created and retained the same promise caching behavior.
